_comment: Per-signal ingest policy (§5.1, M2 design D3). An unrecognised signal is subscribed with no deadband: topology is discovered, so this file will always be incomplete, and losing a stream is worse than storing a few redundant rows.

TaktTime.why: noisy float; 0.05 s is under the jitter sigma

JoiningForcePeak.why: newtons, against a 4200 N nominal and 40 N sigma

LaneFill_1.why: a slow level; sub-unit noise is not a change

Level.why: steps by one; any deadband swallows transitions

PartCount.why: monotonic counter; a deadband loses parts

StateReason.why: string; paired with State at one timestamp
